How Intelligence Alerts works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a business receive automatic alerts when KPIs change?

Choose the KPIs you care about, such as daily sales, bookings or reviews, and set thresholds or let Noxtill flag unusual changes. When one is crossed you are alerted right away, which is how business KPI alerting software becomes real time business analytics alerts.
How does Intelligence Alerts software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

You hear about a problem while there is still time to fix it. When comparing automated business performance alerts, sales KPI notification software or a business metrics alert system, check which metrics can be watched, alert rules, delivery channels and how noise is kept down.
